FIELD GUIDE

How the machine works
Read a token queue; shift a token to stack or reduce a top suffix using grammar cards. Reductions create a tree and compute attached quantities.
Delay a legal reduction when it would attach a modifier to the wrong branch; choose grouping that preserves target interpretation.
Consume input to one requested tree/value within stack bound; stuck stack or wrong final interpretation loses.
